title: CSSOM Construction
definition: The CSS Object Model (CSSOM) is a tree structure representing the CSS rules applied to the DOM. Unlike HTML, CSS is render-blocking because the browser cannot draw the page until it knows all the styling rules.
simpleExplanation: If the DOM is the skeleton of the house, the CSSOM is the paint job and interior design plan.
